items.title: John Altman interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 14, 2023
items.q: I did one with Eartha Kitt... we did this commercial for soap or breakfast cereal

ctx.x: But there were some amazing voiceovers, you know people would come in and you’d be in awe of who showed up. Or singers, you know I did one with Eartha Kitt, I did one with © Fillius Jazz Archive -9-
Mel Torme. It’s amazing to look back and think well, we did this commercial for soap or breakfast cereal and they flew Eartha Kitt into London. And she called me “sir.”
